rich_narrative.summary: Based in Somerset, NJ, the Muslim Foundation provides religious services and runs educational programs such as the Sadiq School and Jafaria School <cite id="2">in FY2023</cite>. Limiting factors reduce the foundation's overall effectiveness, including an excess of idle reserves and a decline in annual funding. In FY2024, the foundation reported <cite id="2">Total Revenue of $2,222,033</cite>, reflecting an 11% revenue decline from $2,504,911 in FY2023. The organization allocates a Program expense ratio of 71.1% toward its community programs, leaving nearly 29% for administrative and operational costs. Charity Navigator evaluates the organization with <cite id="1">an Overall Score of 64/100</cite>. While fundraising costs remain modest, significant financial reserves sit uninvested without a clear long-term plan, limiting immediate operational impact. Donors can support the organization's community programs via <cite id="3">sadaqah contributions on its website</cite>.
